newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate, baht firmer late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate rose further to 11.00-11.50 percent in late trade from 10.00-10.50 in early morning and 8.00-8.25 late on Friday on tighter liquidity, dealers said.

Dealers said the money supply was squeezed today because commercial banks were raising funds to meet the next reserve requirement and payments began for bi-monthly corporate tax drained liquidity from the system.
All commercial banks have to meet the Bank of Thailand's reserve requirements on the seventh and 22nd every month.
"The money supply is expected to be tight for the rest of this week until the passing of reserve requirements," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht was higher at 25.302-25.307 to the dollar in late trade from 25.307-25.312 earlier on strong demand for baht, dealers said.
"The dollar here did not follow its rise against other major today because rising short-term baht interest rates triggered some interest on the baht," said one currency dealer.
